summary: Admin & Instructor Toolbox UIs fully verified end-to-end. ADMIN /admin/instructor-content: admin-toolbox-page renders with all 6 default sections (maps, answer-keys, question-banks, offline-game-packs, teaching-resources, facilitation-notes), each marked 'core' with no delete button. Create/Rename/Toggle/Reorder/Delete on custom section all work (TEST_Custom_Section -> renamed -> moved up -> deleted). Upload publisher asset works and shows in assets-list with 'publisher' badge; Assign Existing modal lists File Manager files (100 shown) and assign-btn-* assigns; remove-asset-* removes. INSTRUCTOR /instructor-toolbox: Overview shows all 6 managed sections PLUS Game Setup + Achievement Awards (8 cards). Disabled section (verified by disabling Facilitation Notes) is correctly HIDDEN from instructor. Answer Keys section renders section-assets-answer-keys with 'Resources' heading, publisher file, working toolbox-asset-download-*, and 'My Class Resources' upload area. Publisher rows on instructor side have NO remove button (only own rows do). Maps section keeps interactive maps-section AND shows section-assets-maps below. Question Banks keeps question-bank-section. Instructor can upload via my-resource-upload-* (file appears as 'My Class Resources') and delete via toolbox-asset-remove-*. Game Setup shows grinch-game-card + passport-game-card; Achievement Awards shows order-medallions-btn + certificates-preview-banner. No audio testids anywhere. All test data cleaned up (custom section deleted, publisher assets removed, Facilitation Notes re-enabled).
critical_code_review_comments: InstructorToolbox.js is 1486 lines (was 1339 before this feature) — past the >700 line threshold; recommend splitting renderSectionAssets / renderMaps / renderQuestionBank / renderCertificates into focused modules.
AdminToolbox.js uses inline closures with eslint-disable-next-line on useCallback deps — works but suggest fixing dependency arrays properly for fetchSections/fetchAssets/load.

AdminToolbox.AssignModal lists max 100 files with hardcoded limit and only client-side filter via search query param — pagination is not implemented; could be an issue once the file count grows past 100. Not blocking.

context_for_next_testing_agent:
Admin Toolbox at /admin/instructor-content (route 'instructor-content/*' in AdminConsole). Section keys are slugged from title (e.g. 'TEST_Custom_Section' -> 'test-custom-section'). Default sections have is_default=true and render a 'core' badge instead of a delete button. Rename uses Enter or blur; rename-input-<key> testid. Upload uses hidden <input type='file' data-testid='upload-asset-input'>; trigger via set_input_files. Assign modal renders 'assign-file-<id>' rows with 'assign-btn-<id>' buttons.

Instructor: tabs are clicked via card click (h3:has-text). Returning to overview uses 'Back to Toolbox Overview' link. section-assets-<key> wraps both Publisher 'Resources' section + 'My Class Resources' upload area for every managed section. Publisher rows have NO toolbox-asset-remove-* (only own rows do). For Maps the maps-section AND section-assets-maps both coexist; same for Question Banks (question-bank-section + section-assets-question-banks). Download click uses authed fetch->blob (no <a href>), so just verify click does not error.

Verified facts: 6 default sections seeded on first GET. Disabled sections are hidden from /api/instructor/toolbox/sections (instructor overview reflects this immediately on reload).
